description: This PHP source file defines a controller class ConfirmationController within the OrangeHRM installer module. The class extends an abstract installer Vue controller and overrides the preRender method to set up a confirmation screen component and update the application state.

classes.name: ConfirmationController
classes.description: Controller handling the confirmation step in the installer process, responsible for rendering the confirmation screen component and updating the application state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the confirmation screen by creating a component and setting the current screen in the state container.
